bulk_dialog_empty_warning: Empty filter — Run will ask you to type the collection name to confirm, since this affects the ENTIRE collection.
new_db_hint: MongoDB creates a database when the first collection is added — enter both.
sql_import_scope_notice: Only CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO are supported — other statements are ignored.
sql_import_no_tables: No CREATE TABLE / INSERT INTO statements found in this file.
sql_import_cancelled_notice: Import cancelled — documents already inserted were not rolled back.
csv_import_parse_json_like: Parse JSON-like text as nested objects/arrays
csv_import_infer_scalars: Infer numbers, booleans, ObjectId, and dates
csv_import_no_columns: No columns found in this file.
sql_export_scope_notice: Writes CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO only — no indexes or constraints. ObjectId, Date, Binary, and nested fields are written as plain text.
export_wizard_nested_field_notice: {n} nested field(s) will be stored as JSON text — not guaranteed to round-trip through other tools.
namespace_panel_disconnect_confirm_messa: Disconnect "{label}"? Unsaved query tabs stay open but can't run anymore.
explain_pane_verdict_ixscan_inefficient: ⚠ Using index {name}, but scanning far more documents than returned
explain_pane_verdict_unrecognized: Explain output not recognized for this server/topology.
query_tab_status_idle: Edit the statement and run it (toolbar ▶ or right-click → Run).
query_tab_session_switch_message: This tab now points at session “{to}”, but was last run against “{from}”. Continuing will run against “{to}”.
pipeline_tree_parse_error: Can't display this script visually — edit it in Script instead.
pipeline_tree_preview_write_stage_blocke: Preview skipped — this pipeline writes to a collection ($out/$merge).
topology_standalone: Standalone server (not part of a replica set or sharded cluster).
current_ops_kill_message: This will terminate operation {opid}. This cannot be undone.
err_roles_not_array: Roles must be a JSON array.
err_privileges_not_array: Privileges must be a JSON array.
document_form_invalid_fields_error: Some fields are invalid — fix them before saving.
result_table_search_title: Quick search (regex, case-insensitive) over the loaded rows
result_grid_depth_title: Maximum nesting depth shown as grid columns
result_table_unsaved_edit_message: This cell was edited. Save the change before leaving it?
result_table_show_all_message: {count} rows may slow down the UI. Show all anyway?
session_manager_tooltip_ssh_lock: Disabled while SSH Tunnel is enabled (single-host only)
session_manager_readonly_enable: Reject all writes on this connection
session_manager_ssh_notice: SSH Tunnel restricts this connection to a single host — SRV and Replica Set are disabled.
session_manager_ssh_forget_host_key_done: Forgotten — the next connect will trust whatever key the server presents.
session_manager_delete_message: Delete saved connection "{label}"? This removes the saved profile only, not any data.
page_empty_state: Select a database or collection to get started
page_quit_message: Are you sure you want to quit? Unsaved work will be lost.
page_reset_default_message: Clears all UI preferences (theme, language, layout, etc.) and reloads. Saved connections and queries are kept.
err_inline_unsupported: Value type not supported for inline edit.
err_update_not_object: Update must be a JSON object.
err_doc_not_object: Document must be a JSON object.
err_filter_invalid_json: Filter is not valid JSON or mongosh syntax.
err_filter_not_object: Filter must be a document (an object), not an array or a single value.
err_coll_name_dollar: Collection name cannot contain the '$' character.
err_coll_name_null_char: Collection name cannot contain a null character.
err_db_name_invalid_chars: Database name contains invalid characters (/ \ . " $ * < > : | ? or space).
err_db_name_too_long: Database name is too long (max 63 bytes).
err_index_no_field: At least one field is required.
collection_view_selection_missing_id: Some selected rows are missing an _id.
collection_view_selection_missing_id_del: Some selected rows are missing an _id to delete.
destructive_confirm_body: This script may modify or delete data using: {ops}
script_critical_confirm_message: This script calls {op}, which cannot be undone and may affect a whole collection or database.
saved_queries_delete_folder_message: Delete folder "{name}"? {count} saved queries inside will also be deleted.
saved_queries_blocked_hint: Saving is disabled to protect the existing library file.
gridfs_preview_cap_message: File exceeds the 5MB preview limit — download it to view.
gridfs_preview_unsupported: This file type can't be previewed.
gridfs_pdf_fallback_link: PDF not displaying? Open/download it directly
palette_placeholder: Type a command, or jump to a database or collection…
peek_stale_note: This document is no longer in this page of results — your unsaved edits are kept.
peek_dirty_message: Save your changes to this document?
peek_still_editing: You're still editing this document — save or discard to act on the selection.
env_suggest_prod: Looks like production — mark as PROD?
env_suggest_staging: Looks like staging — mark as STAGING?
env_suggest_dev: Looks like a dev server — mark as DEV?
undo_conflict_message: This document changed since your edit. Overwrite it with the earlier version?
conn_uri_placeholder: Paste a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// URI
conn_empty_paste: Paste a connection string to get started
undo_snapshot_failed: Couldn't keep a copy of the deleted documents — this delete can't be undone.
undo_expired: That change can no longer be undone.
undo_failed_restore: Restored {restored} of {total}; {failed} could not be written and stay in the undo list.
query_tab_stale_after_undo: Documents in these results changed (undo). Run again to refresh.
document_form_changed_note: This document was changed by an undo. Reopen it to see the current version.
session_manager_connect_failed: Connection failed. Check your connection settings and try again.
script_confirm_session_changed: The session changed while the confirmation was open. The script was not run; run it again.
chips_or_title: Match either value (joins into one “is any of”)
chips_slow: No index on this field — may be slow on a large collection
chips_invalid_value: Doesn't look like a valid value for this field
chips_quick_invalid: Couldn't read that — try status:shipped or total>100
builder_discarded: {count} disabled stage(s) were discarded because the script was edited directly.
builder_empty: Start with a filter, a group, or a template.
builder_warn_match_after_reshape: $match after a reshaping stage can't use an index — move it earlier if you can.
builder_warn_lookup_unindexed: The joined field has no index in the other collection — this can be slow.
builder_warn_writes_disable_preview: This stage writes data — preview and counts stop before it.
builder_warn_zero_docs: No documents pass this step — check its conditions.
builder_unwind_keep: Keep documents with an empty or missing array
history_replace_message: This tab has a different script. Replace it with the one from history?
explain_advice_create_index: An index on the filtered fields would avoid reading every document.
explain_advice_move_match_first: A $match after a reshaping stage can't use an index — move it to the front.
explain_advice_in_memory_sort: This sort runs in memory (limited to 100 MB) — an index matching the sort would avoid it.
explain_prod_note: This creates the index on PROD.
overview_profiler_off: Profiler is off — only running operations are shown.
overview_profiler_hint: To record finished slow queries, run in the database:
index_low_confidence: Only {count} days of usage data — not enough to conclude.
index_low_confidence_one: Only 1 day of usage data — not enough to conclude.
index_replica_note: Uses are counted on {host} only — reads served by secondaries are not visible.
index_sharded_note: Uses are summed across all shards.
index_hide_old: Hiding an index needs MongoDB 4.4 or newer
index_hide_body: The query planner will ignore this index, but it is still kept up to date. You can unhide it any time, instantly.
index_drop_advice_body: Hiding {name} is reversible: if anything slows down, unhide it instantly. Dropping it means rebuilding it later.
dbidx_none: No unused or rarely used indexes found
ref_search_confirm: This looks in every collection of a PROD database, one at a time. Continue?
ref_not_found_anywhere: Not found in any collection of this database
welcome_paste_invalid: That doesn't look like a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection string.
err_conn_unreachable: Can't reach the server. The connection may have dropped or the cluster is unreachable — check your network and try reconnecting.
err_conn_atlas_unreachable: Can't reach the Atlas cluster. Make sure your current IP address is on the cluster's Network Access list, then reconnect.
err_conn_refused: Nothing is accepting connections at that host and port. Check that mongod is running and the port is correct.
err_conn_tls: The TLS/SSL handshake failed. Check whether the server requires TLS and that your certificate settings match.
err_auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the username, password and authentication database (authSource), then reconnect.
err_conn_dns: Couldn't resolve the server address. Check the host name in the connection and your network.
err_not_authorized: Your user isn't allowed to do this on database "{db}" (missing privilege).
err_dup_key_index: A document with this value already exists (duplicate key on index "{index}").
err_dup_key: A document with this value already exists (duplicate key).
err_validation_failed: This document doesn't satisfy the collection's validation rules.
pager_query_time_title: Round-trip time of the query behind these rows
pager_deep_page_hint: Deep page is slow — add a filter or sort by an indexed field
pending_missing: Skipped {count} changes: the document no longer exists
pending_missing_one: Skipped 1 change: the document no longer exists
pending_discard_message: Discard {count} unsaved changes? The cells go back to their stored values.
pending_discard_message_one: Discard 1 unsaved change? The cell goes back to its stored value.
pending_quit_warning: {count} cell edits have not been committed and will be lost.
pending_quit_warning_one: 1 cell edit has not been committed and will be lost.
views_apply_title: Apply this view's filter, sort and columns
query_template_find: Find with filter, sort and limit
import_dialog_hint: Choose a JSON, JSONL, BSON, CSV or SQL dump file. The format is detected from its extension.
import_dialog_large_notice: This file is {size}. Importing it can take a while; you can keep working while it runs in the background.
export_format_hint_json: Extended JSON array: keeps every BSON type and can be imported back as is.
export_format_hint_csv: A flat table for spreadsheets; sub-documents become dotted columns and BSON types become text.
export_format_hint_bson: Raw BSON, as mongodump writes it: exact and compact, for mongorestore or re-import.
export_format_hint_sql: CREATE TABLE and INSERT statements for loading into a relational database.
command_log_copied_partial: Only the start of this command is still available — copied that part
command_log_incomplete: Only the first {count} of {total} characters are still in memory. Turn on “Save to file” in the log panel to keep full commands.
command_log_to_file_title: Also write every command in full to a daily log file (kept 7 days, up to 100 MB). Off by default because the file contains your queries and document data.
command_log_copy_path_title: Copy the path of the folder holding the log files
command_log_clear_files_message: All saved command log files are deleted from disk. Commands still in the panel keep what is in memory.
watch_op_chip_hint: Click to show/hide · double-click (or Alt+click) to show only this
watch_standalone_title: Change streams need a replica set
watch_standalone_body: This server is a standalone mongod, which has no oplog to read changes from. For local debugging, restart it as a one-member replica set (keeps your data), then initiate it once:
watch_dropped: {count} older events were dropped to keep memory in check.
watch_waiting: Waiting for changes in {scope}… run your app or make a write.
watch_paused_empty: Paused. Press Record to capture changes.
watch_select_hint: Select an event to see what changed and the document's history.
watch_deleted_unknown: Deleted. Its content is unknown: it did not appear earlier in this recording.
watch_other_event: "{type}" event — see Event JSON for details.
watch_before_unknown: Previous values are unknown: this document had not appeared earlier in this recording. Showing the fields that changed and their new values.
watch_before_unknown_preimages: Previous values are unknown: this document had not appeared earlier in this recording. To always get them, enable changeStreamPreAndPostImages on the collection (MongoDB 6.0+).
watch_before_from_preimage: Previous values come from the server's pre-image.
watch_history_note: Only changes captured while this tab was recording are listed.
loading_documents_slow: Still loading after {seconds}s — large collections or heavy documents can take a while.
watch_changes_denied_body: This user can't open a change stream on {scope}. It needs the changeStream and find actions there — for example the read role on the database.
watch_q_deployment_title: Pick a database to watch queries
watch_q_deployment_body: The profiler is turned on per database. Open Watch from a database or collection (right-click it in the tree) to follow its queries.
watch_q_mongos_body: On a sharded cluster the profiler runs on each shard, not on mongos. Connect directly to a shard's primary to watch its queries.
watch_q_readonly_body: Watching queries turns the database profiler on, which changes a server setting. Use a connection that isn't marked read-only.
watch_q_denied_title: No permission to turn the profiler on
watch_q_denied_body: This user can't change profiling on {db}. It needs the enableProfiler action — for example the dbAdmin role on that database.
watch_q_unsupported_title: This server doesn't offer the profiler
watch_q_unsupported_body: Some hosted servers (such as Atlas shared tiers and serverless) don't allow the database profiler. Use the provider's own query insights instead.
watch_q_start_body: Turns on the database profiler and lists every query as it runs: how long it took, whether it used an index, and how many documents it read.
watch_q_capture_all_hint: The full picture while you debug. Adds some load — best on dev or test servers.
watch_q_capture_slow_hint: Lighter. The threshold (slowms) applies to the whole server while recording.
watch_q_coll_note: The profiler is turned on for all of {db}; only queries on {coll} are listed.
watch_q_restore_note: Pausing or closing this tab puts the previous profiler setting back.
watch_q_needs_index_hint: Only queries that scanned the whole collection or read far more documents than they returned
watch_q_search_placeholder: Filter by collection, command or filter…
watch_q_waiting: Waiting for queries… run your app.
watch_q_select_hint: Select a query to see its plan, what it read and the full command.
watch_q_hint_collscan: Scanned the whole collection ({examined} documents). An index on the filtered fields would help.
watch_q_hint_ratio: Read {examined} documents to return {returned}. A more selective index would help.
mcp_intro: Let AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, VS Code…) browse and query the connections open in LumioNG through the Model Context Protocol. The server listens on this computer only, and every request must carry the access token below.
mcp_allow_writes_hint: Never applies to read-only or production connections; updates and deletes need a non-empty filter.
mcp_regenerate_hint: Clients still using the old token stop working.
mcp_no_connections: No connection is open — clients will see an empty list.
statusbar_mcp_title: MCP server running on port {port} — {count} tool calls
builder_warn_sort_after_limit: $sort after $limit only orders the documents that survived the limit — sort first if you want the top ones.
conn_secret_keychain: 🔒 Saved passwords are kept in the system keychain
conn_secret_file: System keychain unavailable — saved passwords are kept obfuscated in the settings file
crash_dialog_message: The app crashed last time. A report was saved on this computer only — nothing was sent anywhere. Copy it if you want to attach it to a bug report.
audit_intro: Every write made through LumioNG (grid, console, imports, MCP) on the audited environments is appended to a tamper-evident log on this computer. Filters are stored with string values hidden; no document data is recorded.
audit_empty: No audited writes in this period.
audit_verify_broken: Chain broken in {file} at line {line}: that line or the one before it was edited, or lines were removed.
audit_export_failed: Could not export the audit log: {error}
mcp_redact_fields_hint: Values of fields with these names (comma-separated, any depth, case-insensitive; * is a wildcard) are replaced with [redacted] in what MCP clients receive, and queries cannot filter or sort on them.
mcp_audit_reads_hint: MCP writes are always recorded in the audit log; this adds finds, counts and other reads.
conn_mcp_access_prod_hint: Production connections can never be written to through MCP.
audit_verify_torn: {count} half-written line(s) left by a crash were skipped; this is not tampering.
vault_unlock_message: This computer has no system keychain, so LumioNG keeps your saved connection passwords encrypted under a master password. Enter it to connect to connections that have a saved password.
vault_setup_message: This computer has no system keychain, so your saved connection passwords are only lightly obfuscated on disk. Choose a master password to encrypt them (AES-256). You will enter it each time you start LumioNG.
vault_no_recovery: There is no way to recover a forgotten master password. If you lose it, saved passwords must be erased and typed in again.
vault_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
vault_reset_message: This permanently deletes every saved connection password, SSH password and key passphrase. Your connections stay, but you will have to enter their passwords again. This cannot be undone and there is no recovery.
vault_reset_done: Saved passwords erased. Enter them again when you connect.
vault_save_refused: The password was not saved: this computer has no system keychain, so saved passwords need a master password first.
vault_saved_without_password: Connection saved without its password. Enter it each time you connect.
vault_migration_reenter: Passwords of old-format connections could not be kept (no master password yet): {labels}. Set up the vault, then enter them again.
session_degraded_toast: Lost contact with {label}. Retrying in the background.
diag_all_passed: Every step passed. The problem may be intermittent; try connecting again.
session_degraded_ssh_toast: Lost contact with {label}: the SSH tunnel to {endpoint} is down.
session_manager_proxy_socks_notice: SOCKS5 is applied to every host of the connection, including replica set members and SRV.
session_manager_proxy_http_notice: An HTTP proxy tunnels a single host — SRV and Replica Set are disabled. SSH Tunnel cannot be combined with a proxy.
session_manager_proxy_ssh_conflict: SSH Tunnel is enabled: turn it off or choose no proxy.
conn_aws_hint: Leave all three empty to use the AWS environment variables, instance profile, ECS or EKS credentials.
conn_kerberos_hint: Uses the ticket already held by your operating system (kinit on Linux and macOS, your Windows sign-in). No password is stored.
conn_aws_needs_key_id: An AWS secret or session token needs an access key ID. Fill the access key ID, or clear all three fields to use the environment credentials.
conn_aws_needs_secret: An AWS access key ID needs its secret access key. Fill the secret, or clear all three fields to use the environment credentials.
conn_tls_tunnel_hostname_hint: TLS is on while the connection goes through an SSH tunnel or HTTP proxy: the server is reached as 127.0.0.1, so certificate hostname verification fails unless you add tlsAllowInvalidHostnames=true to the extra options.
conn_oidc_hint_workforce: Opens your browser to sign in at the identity provider. Register http://localhost:27097/redirect as a redirect URI there. The refresh token is kept in the OS keychain (or sealed by the master password); without either it lasts only for this session.
conn_oidc_hint_workload: Uses the identity of the machine this app runs on. Nothing is stored.
menu_native_frame_hint: Draws the operating system's own title bar and window buttons instead of LumioNG's. On Windows 11 only the system frame supports the snap-layout flyout when hovering the maximize button (Win+Left/Right works either way).
workspace_restore_message: Restore {count} tab(s) from the previous session? Nothing is run automatically.
workspace_restore_dropped: {count} tab(s) belong to deleted connections and are skipped.
workspace_restore_prod_message: These connections are not marked DEV or STAGING. Reconnect to them and reopen their tabs?
workspace_restore_unlock_cancelled: Vault unlock cancelled; the remaining tabs were not restored.
workspace_restore_connect_failed: Could not reconnect to {label}; its tabs were not restored.
validator_editor_empty: No fields yet — add one or create from sample data
validator_editor_load_error: Stored validator can't be read, saving is disabled until the JSON is fixed: {message}
validator_editor_locked: $jsonSchema is not an object, so it can only be edited in the JSON tab.
dbdiag_truncated: Only the first {max} collections were analyzed.
dbdiag_none: No references found between collections. Fields are matched by name (userId → users) and checked against sampled data.
dbdiag_hint: Inferred from names and a sample of values. Dashed lines are guesses; click a line to confirm, remove or open it.
dbdiag_canvas_aria: Collections and the references between them
compare_truncated: More than 100,000 differences: the counts are complete, the list holds the first 100,000.
compare_identical: Both collections hold the same documents.
compare_changes: Changes a sync in the current direction would make
compare_no_field_changes: No field changes left (the document may have changed since the comparison).
compare_delete_extra: Delete documents the other side does not have
compare_dry_result: Dry run: would insert {insert}, replace {replace}, delete {delete}.
compare_apply_hint: Run a dry run of exactly these settings first.
compare_prod_warning: The written side is PROD. You will have to type the collection name to confirm.
compare_read_only: The written side is a read-only connection, so it cannot be synced.
compare_sync_done: Sync done: {insert} inserted, {replace} replaced, {delete} deleted, {failed} failed.
compare_sync_cancelled: Stopped. Batches already sent stay written.
compare_nothing_to_sync: Nothing to write for these settings.
compare_err_pick_sides: Pick a connection, database and collection on both sides.
compare_err_same: Source and destination are the same collection.
compare_err_read_only: The written side is a read-only connection.
compare_err_plan_changed: The sync settings changed; run the dry run again.
compare_ignore_hint: Ignored paths apply to fields and embedded documents, not inside arrays.
compare_type_conflicts: {count} pair(s) with _id values of different types: type change — cannot replace in place, skipped.
search_index_edit_note: Only the definition can change. Atlas rebuilds the index in the background.
search_index_empty: No search indexes on this collection.
search_index_unsupported: This server does not support Atlas Search indexes. They are available on MongoDB Atlas and Atlas Local.
search_index_problem_json: The definition is not valid JSON.
search_index_problem_object: The definition must be a JSON object.
search_index_problem_searchMappings: A search index definition needs a "mappings" object.
search_index_problem_vectorFields: A vector search definition needs a non-empty "fields" array.
atlas_browser_help: Sign in with an Atlas Service Account (Organization > Access Manager > Applications). Its access list must include this machine's IP address.
atlas_no_connection: No connection string (paused or not ready)
atlas_user_hint: Atlas does not provide database credentials: enter your database user and password in the connection form.
atlas_stored_keychain: Secret stored in the system keychain.
atlas_stored_vault: Secret stored in the master-password vault.
atlas_vault_refused: The secret could not be stored: unlock or set up the master password, then try again.
csfle_save_first: Save the connection first, then set up encryption.
csfle_intro: Client-side field level encryption. Fields encrypted with a data key are decrypted automatically when you read them. Writing an encrypted value is explicit: use "Encrypt with key…" in the document editor. Takes effect the next time you connect.
csfle_local_hint: A file of exactly 96 bytes. Its content is copied into the credential store; keep a backup of the file, because losing the key makes the data unreadable.
csfle_keep_hint: Leave blank to keep the stored value
csfle_crypt_shared_hint: For Queryable Encryption. Only the location is stored in this version; queries are not encrypted automatically.
csfle_problem_namespace: The key vault must look like database.collection.
csfle_problem_providers: Choose at least one KMS provider.
csfle_problem_credentials: Enter the credentials of every selected provider.
csfle_saved_keychain: Saved. Credentials are in the system keychain.
csfle_saved_vault: Saved. Credentials are sealed by the master password.
csfle_alg_deterministic: Deterministic (same value, same ciphertext; equality can be queried)
csfle_no_keys: The key vault has no data keys yet. Create one.
csfle_edit_warning: Encrypted fields are shown decrypted. Saving writes them back as plain text unless you encrypt them again with "Encrypt with key…".
csfle_duplicate_failed: Could not read the encrypted source document, so it was not duplicated.
csfle_encrypted_badge_title: Stored encrypted in the database; shown decrypted here. Unchanged, it is saved back as ciphertext.
csfle_decrypt_unavailable: Decryption unavailable: {reason}. Encrypted fields are shown as ciphertext.
csfle_decrypt_key_missing: the data key was not found in the key vault
csfle_decrypt_kms: the key management service could not be reached or refused the credentials
csfle_decrypt_generic: the encryption library reported an error
err_csfle_plaintext_required: Encrypted field(s) {paths} cannot be changed here. Open the document editor and use "Encrypt with key…", or confirm saving them as plain text.
csfle_export_notice: This connection decrypts encrypted fields: the exported file will contain them as plain text.
destructive_title_storePlaintext: Store encrypted fields as plain text
import_dialog_hint_db: Choose one file, several files (one collection each) or a whole folder, such as a mongodump database directory. The format is detected from each file's extension.
import_batch_skip_sql: SQL dump: import it on its own
import_batch_skip_metadata: mongodump metadata, applied with the data files
import_batch_none: No JSON, JSONL, BSON or CSV files to import.
import_batch_csv_note: CSV files are read with the default options (comma separated, values typed automatically).
err_coll_name_duplicate: Another file imports into this collection.
